description: This Dart source file defines error handling for API responses in a Flutter application, including error codes, data structures for API error details, and exception classes for managing API errors and mapping server responses to UI-friendly messages.

classes.name: BackendErrorCode

classes.name: ApiErrorDetails
classes.description: A class encapsulating detailed information about API errors, including error codes, user messages, HTTP status, and optional retry/lockout durations.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: An exception class wrapping API error details, allowing for easy error propagation and handling, with support for constructing from raw messages or detailed error info.
